doc: The personal-notes canary (Urdr Task 19; storage §5.6). Random bytes made here sit in ~/org/notes.org, ~/org/other.md and ~/org/reading.org (opted in, with notes.org: that opt-in opens nothing). A schema-6 work.db holding the first two (spec, file, link and dot-dot forms) is migrated at hub start; the Lisp scan reads HOME and HOME/org, where plans name ../../org/notes.org, a link to it, a linked folder into org and the opted-in reading.org as their specs, and the board's TODO is read; a tampered export is imported; the Lisp search indexer runs on HOME (as a project holding org/) against a mock TEI and is refused a project inside org; reading.org's opt-in is revoked; the store is exported. No canary is in work.db, its WAL, the code index, the export, the TEI requests or the hub log, and no file under HOME/org changed.

args: set -e; export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null; ln -s $HOME/org/notes.org $HOME/proj/n.org; ln -s ../org $HOME/proj/o; ln -s $HOME/org/notes.org $HOME/n.org; ln -s $HOME/org $HOME/linkdir; mkdir -p $HOME/org/proj; git init -q $HOME; git init -q $HOME/proj; git init -q $HOME/org/proj; printf ';; inside org\n' > $HOME/org/proj/main.el

set -e; cd $HOME/org; find . -path ./proj/.git -prune -o -print | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs stat -c '%n %s %Y %a' > $ROOT/org.before; find . -path ./proj/.git -prune -o -type f -print | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum >> $ROOT/org.before

sql: select count(*) from entity where id = 'plan:$HOME/proj/plans/old.md'
select count(*) from entity where id = 'todo:$HOME/org/board.org#1' and kind = 'todo' and title like '%marker-board-19c%'
select count(*) from entity where id = 'spec:$HOME/org/reading.org' and instr(title, '$reading') > 0
select count(*) from entity where id in ('plan:$HOME/proj/plans/a.md', 'plan:$HOME/proj/plans/b.md', 'plan:$HOME/proj/plans/c.md', 'plan:$HOME/proj/plans/d.md')
select count(*) from entity where instr(replace(replace(id || ' ' || coalesce(source, '') || ' ' || data, '$HOME/org/board.org', ''), '$HOME/org/reading.org', ''), '$HOME/org/') > 0
select count(*) from entity where id = 'note:plain'

expect_stdout: the search index never reads ~/org (personal notes)

sql: select (select count(*) from entity where instr(id || coalesce(title, '') || data, '$reading') > 0) + (select count(*) from entity_hist where instr(coalesce(title, '') || coalesce(data, ''), '$reading') > 0)

args: set -e; cd $HOME/org; find . -path ./proj/.git -prune -o -print | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs stat -c '%n %s %Y %a' > $ROOT/org.after; find . -path ./proj/.git -prune -o -type f -print | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum >> $ROOT/org.after; cmp $ROOT/org.before $ROOT/org.after
